question: In which of the following Olympic games did India NOT win Gold?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1960.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• In **Men's Olympic Field Hockey**, the Indian team has won the most gold medals, **10** in total.
 
• The Indian men's hockey team has won eight Olympic gold medals in total, six in a row (from 1928 to 1956, including 1936 Berlin), and two more in **Tokyo **in **1964 **and Moscow in **1980**.
 
• India won the silver medal in the **1960 Rome Olympics **after **losing **to **Pakistan **(gold medal), ending India's run of six consecutive gold medals.
 
• When **Abhinav Bindra** won gold in the 10-metre Air rifle event at the 2008 Olympics in Beijing, he became the first Indian to win an individual Olympic gold medal.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is second individual Olympic champion after Abhinav Bindra. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Here's when and how India won gold at the Olympics:
 
 
• Indian men’s hockey team -** Amsterdam 1928.**
 
• Indian men’s hockey team -** Los Angeles 1932.**
 
• Indian men’s hockey team -** Berlin 1936.**
 
• Indian men’s hockey team - **London 1948.**
 
• Indian men’s hockey team - **Helsinki 1952.**
 
• Indian men’s hockey team - **Melbourne 1956.**
 
• Indian men’s hockey team - **Tokyo 1964.**
 
• Indian men’s hockey team -** Moscow 1980.**
 
• Abhinav Bindra in men’s 10m air rifle shooting - **Beijing 2008.**
 
• Neeraj Chopra in the men's javelin throw -** Tokyo 2020.**
